question: Should OpenClaw accept `decision: null` as the permanent public plugin approval resolved-event contract for requester cancellation?
rationale: The patch changes an exported plugin approval event/type shape that channel and plugin SDK consumers may observe, and automation cannot choose the long-term API contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept nullable cancellation
options.body: Land the null-decision cleanup model after all abort-aware waiters and consumer coverage are complete.

options.title: Use an explicit cancellation state
options.body: Require a distinct non-null cancellation state and update protocol, SDK, renderers, and tests around that contract.

options.title: Pause the API change
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers settle the public approval-resolution contract separately.

recommendation.title: Accept nullable cancellation
recommendation.body: Land the null-decision cleanup model after all abort-aware waiters and consumer coverage are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant is the clearest history-backed routing candidate for approval-flow hardening and the original feature merge path.
